title: Pais told Ashton Forbes that the MH370 orbs show the Pais effect

tellings.quote: All I'm saying is when I saw that thing open up, I saw the pis effect on action and I told Ashen Ford that was his first podcast, hard truths podcast. I told him this is the Pis.

plain: Salvatore Pais, a Navy scientist who holds patents on unusual propulsion ideas, told podcast host Jesse Michels about videos said to show orbs around MH370, a passenger plane that went missing. Pais says that when he saw the thing in the video "open up" he saw the "Pais effect," a physics effect named after him, in action, and that he told Ashton Forbes so on Forbes's first show, the Hard Truths podcast, around 2023. If true, it would tie his own theories to what happened to the plane.
